title_en: Movies, Games, Editing: It All Happens on the Lenovo Legion 5i Laptop's Display - IGN
body_en:
Media viewing is becoming more of a one-on-one experience: one person, one monitor. Long gone are the days of a family competing over a television in the living room. Watching movies, playing video games, browsing the internet, doing homework, and a multitude of other visual tasks are increasingly happening through a single monitor.
There's no use in having a laptop that's powerful enough to do it all if it's not attached to a premium display. Why go to the effort of fine-tuning your game’s visual performance if you’re seeing the world through a sub-par monitor? How can you trust your videos look good to your viewers if they don’t look good to you? The Lenovo Legion 5i laptop's 15.3" WQXGA OLED display gives you plenty of space to spread out all your tasks, whether those involve gaming, homework, video editing, or all three at once.
The screen's snappy 165Hz refresh rate allows for smoother motion on-screen. Speed past screen tearing and lag with NVIDIA G-SYNC support, which syncs your monitor's refresh rate to your graphics card's frame rate for optimal performance. Watch movies in a brand-new light with the Lenovo Legion 5i’s DisplayHDR True Black 1000. And it's all on one laptop that doesn't compromise performance for its features.
Sitting in front of your monitor is no longer passive; we create as much as we watch. The Legion 5i laptop's wide screen is ideal for keeping an eye on several creative tasks at once, like gaming, streaming, editing, or filming. Its 100% DCI-P3 color coverage gives you a vivid color palette to work with. And its OLED panel tech ensures a crisp, clean image that draws you into your favorite game or movie with its rich colors and deeper contrast.
The Lenovo Legion 5i laptop is built to multitask without compromise. That promise is clearly realized through its versatile but powerful 15.3-inch monitor that lets you see the best side of the media you watch and the stuff you make. No matter what you're doing, the Lenovo Legion 5i 's laptop screen lets you do it or watch it in uncompromised comfort.
